name: Texture Flow
description: Analyzes テキストure flow coherence
algorithm: Texture Flow — ピクセルレベル空間分析
mechanism:
This method analyzes texture flow patterns in video for deepfake detection:

1. **テクスチャFlow推定**: The motion field of texture elements (rather than edge features) is estimated using oriented texture correlation between frames. This captures how textured regions (skin, hair, fabric) move over time.

2. **テクスチャ-動き一貫性**: Texture flow should be consistent with optical flow — texture moves with the surface it belongs to. The method compares texture flow with geometric optical flow (from edge features). Inconsistencies indicate texture that moves independently of the underlying geometry — a possible AI generation artifact.

3. **表面-テクスチャコヒーレンス**: As surfaces rotate, textures foreshorten according to perspective. The method checks whether texture deformation is consistent with the estimated surface orientation change. Deepfake face generators may rotate faces without properly foreshortening skin texture.

4. **テクスチャ時間的安定性**: Fixed textures (skin pores, wrinkles, fabric pattern) should maintain their spatial relationship to surface geometry across frames. The method tracks texture-surface binding — texture that "slides" relative to the surface (like a projection rather than a surface property) indicates AI rendering.

5. **テクスチャFlowBoundaries**: Texture flow should be continuous within objects and show discontinuities only at object boundaries (depth edges, occlusion boundaries). The method detects texture flow discontinuities within surfaces — internal flow breaks corresponding to face-swap boundaries reveal the extent of generated regions.
parameters:
分析タイプ: ピクセル
メディア: 動画
入力: Video frames extracted at key intervals
出力: 信頼度スコア (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: 中〜高 — 70-88% 単独精度. Most effective when combined with other 動画 forensic methods. Performance depends on 動画 quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detection of deepfake and AI-generated 動画 through テキストure flow analysis. This method examines temporal and spatial features that are difficult for AI systems to perfectly replicate, providing evidence for 動画 authenticity assessment.
strengths:
• Captures temporal artifacts that single-frame analysis misses
• Works with standard 動画 formats
• Effective against common deepfake techniques
• Can be combined with other 動画 forensic methods
• Based on established computer vision research
limitations:
• Performance affected by 動画 compression and resolution
• Some methods require sufficient frame count for temporal analysis
• Effectiveness varies with deepfake generation technique
• Best used as part of a comprehensive multi-method pipeline
